annotation.title_clean: 关于印发《关于加快农业保险高质量发展的实施方案》的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Plan on Accelerating High-Quality Development of Agricultural Insurance
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 财政部; 农业农村部; 金融监管总局; 国家林草局
annotation.summary_en: Chinese ministries' implementation plan for high-quality development of agricultural insurance by 2030, covering multi-layer insurance products, subsidy management, claims, catastrophe reserves and reinsurance. Mentions use of drones, remote sensing, IoT and AI in underwriting only in passing; no robotics governance.
key_provisions_or_claims: Targets by 2030: insurance depth 1.9%, density 1200 yuan/person, 90% coverage of three staple crops
Build multi-layer agricultural insurance system with full-cost and income insurance
Insurers should apply drones, remote sensing, IoT, AI and blockchain and develop technology standards
Strengthen subsidy oversight and crack down on fraudulent claims
Establish catastrophe risk fund and strengthen reinsurance; revise Agricultural Insurance Regulations
